t0016-01.gloss: A delivery key remains with a route whose return was cancelled.
t0016-01.rival_reading: A field van could change its route when access changed and leave the key with an old map; the crossed line need not be an order to abandon anyone.

t0016-02.gloss: Field stock travelled together with a trace on one seam.
t0016-02.rival_reading: Emergency crews could move farm supplies in a van during a road closure; a stain and clean label do not establish a failed agricultural program.
